summary: SAML attribute rename ('teamCode' -> 'team_code_v2') prevents entitlement mapping to Internal Debugger
description: Issue summary: After last night's IdP attribute normalization rollout, SAML assertions to Redwood's auth-proxy include the attribute 'team_code_v2' rather than the previous 'teamCode'. The RBAC service looks for the legacy attribute and fails to map team-based entitlements for the Internal Debugger app.

Impact: A subset of engineers (approx 12 users across two teams) can authenticate to the console but receive '403 - Insufficient entitlements' when attempting to open Internal Debugger. This blocks debugging access and impacts oncall effectiveness during investigations.
Environment: Production (prod|us-east-1), affected users onboarded via the new IdP normalization rollout completed 2026-03-11 22:00 UTC.
Business impact: Oncall and SRE workflows delayed; workaround requires manual entitlement grant which is time-consuming and error-prone.
First noticed: 2026-03-12 07:45 UTC by oncall (Pager duty).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Authenticate via company SSO (Okta) into console as a user with team membership recorded under the new IdP attribute.
2) Navigate to Internal Debugger (console -> Tools -> Internal Debugger).
3) Observe successful console login but '403 - Insufficient entitlements' modal when opening the app.
4) Capture SAML assertion sent to auth-proxy (see logs).
logs: 2026-03-12T07:46:22Z auth-proxy INFO Received SAML assertion for user marcos.silva@redwood.com
2026-03-12T07:46:22Z rbac-service WARN No 'teamCode' attribute found, skipping team entitlement mapping for user marcos.silva@redwood.com
2026-03-12T07:46:22Z console ERROR Entitlement check failed: user lacks 'internal:debugger:open' permission (mapped_roles=[])
Stack traces and full SAML blobs attached to ticket in secure storage (link in related_confluence_pages).
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: IdP attribute normalization changed attribute key without a backward-compatible alias; RBAC mapping expects legacy key 'teamCode'.
Confirmed by replaying SAML assertion: new attribute key 'team_code_v2' present and legacy key absent for affected users.
IdP rollout timeline: normalization pushed 2026-03-11 22:00 UTC (release notes reference provided by IdP team).
Auth-proxy currently copies assertion attributes into request context verbatim; no translation layer is present.
Temporary workaround: manual entitlement assignment via admin console grants access while a fix is deployed. Applied to 12 affected users by CS/admins at 2026-03-12 09:05 UTC.
Risk assessment: low risk to auth; however entitlements remain incorrect until mapping is updated. Must avoid broad manual grants.
Owners: identity-proxy (Evelyn Cho), rbac-service (Sanjay Rao), SSO/IdP liaison (Priya Nair).
comments: Marcos Silva (Reporter) 2026-03-12 07:50: 'I can log into the console but Internal Debugger shows 403. I attached the debug SAML assertion.'
Support (Tier 1) 2026-03-12 08:05: 'Thanks Marcos — assigning to identity team to validate SAML attributes. Temporary admin grant applied to unblock oncall.'
Evelyn Cho (Identity) 2026-03-12 09:30: 'Confirmed attribute rename. Working on small middleware patch to translate team_code_v2 -> teamCode for entitlement mapping. Draft PR opened.'
Sanjay Rao (RBAC) 2026-03-12 10:12: 'Will add an acceptance test asserting entitlement mapping when either attribute key is present. Avoiding breaking change.'
Priya Nair (IdP Liaison) 2026-03-12 11:01: 'IdP team acknowledges rename; they can add a compatibility alias on their side but prefer us to accept the new key. We'll coordinate rollout window.'
Support (Tier 1) 2026-03-13 03:20: 'Patch merged to identity-proxy; staged in canary for 2 hours with no regressions. Scheduling prod rollout.'
resolution: Root cause: IdP attribute normalization renamed 'teamCode' to 'team_code_v2'. RBAC mapping logic only looked for 'teamCode'.
Fix: identity-proxy patched to map 'team_code_v2' to 'teamCode' in request context (accept both keys). PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/894
RBAC: added unit and integration tests to accept either attribute key. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac-service/pull/412
Rollout notes: Canary deployed 2026-03-13 01:00 UTC for us-east-1; full prod rollout 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC. Verified affected users regained access without manual entitlements.
Workaround documented: Admins should not grant broad org-level access; instead use temporary per-user grants listed under 'Admin -> User Entitlements' until fix is applied.

Postmortem action items: (1) Add attribute-compatibility checks to deployment checklist for IdP changes; (2) Add telemetry alert when entitlement mapping returns empty role sets for authenticated users; (3) Coordinate with IdP team to publish mapping changes in advance.
Ticket status: Will transition to Resolved after follow-up telemetry check (scheduled 2026-03-15).
